Finance Minister Urges Youth to Embrace Leadership and National Service

Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has called upon Gen Z and Gen Alpha to embrace leadership roles and prioritize the nation. Speaking to these younger generations, she urged them to consider their contributions to India. The minister's message emphasized a call to action for youth to actively participate in national development and leadership.
